jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a commodity management professional (f/m/d) you are the strategic procurement owner of the respective commodities within Gas Services Central Service Business. Role requires individual to develop and align a resilient Ecosystem strategy together with commodity circles and in line with global SE strategy and Global Service Operations (GSO & its Regions) objectives. Typical day for Commodity Management professional includes provide and demonstrate supply market knowledge beyond Procurement perspectives to generate value and impact, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, business case and sourcing strategy preparation/execution, reporting, problem solving, supply chain risk mitigation  as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. How You’ll Make an Impact* Develop and execute Comprehensive Commodity Strategies (forward-looking) aimed at achieving business objectives (Growth, Resilience & Cost Out) for Global Service Operations & the Regions * Lead Cross functional Commodity Circle Team that embodies “Value Creation” mindset and drives improvements in cost, on-time delivery, quality, and lead times, while ensuring adequate capacity. The successful candidate will be the strategic leader for assigned commodities.  * Provide strategic vision and represents their respective business interests into a global commodity team. Act as a role model for ownership, innovation, and transformation aligned with Siemens Energy’s values and strategy; Lead and develop assigned team members in commodity. * Works on commodity structure and provide periodic updates of commodity health to Strategic Procurement leadership and key customers, shares supplier market intelligence across Siemens Energy; Define and implement negotiation concepts and strategies to maximize savings; negotiate frame contracts and price lists * Supplier Management: Supplier selection, incl. documentation/onboarding and communication of strategic suppliers. Strategic evaluations, supplier classifications and supplier development to ensure an optimum supply chain.* Handle relationships with strategic suppliers to ensure alignment with company demands, enabling early supplier involvement and driving cost-out initiatives; Identify procurement risks and opportunities through supplier market analysis and scouting, integrating findings into ecosystem strategies for continuous improvement of managed spend.What You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's Degree, or equivalent experience in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or related field; long term of work experience in the procurement area and a proven track record, ideally in a global organization* Strong commercial and technical understanding and knowledge of procurement, project management, and international contract law* Experience in functional leadership and project management is required* Long term experience in multinational Procurement/ Supply Chain function* Fluent language skills in English(primary) and German(secondary) languageAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

**Location: Copenhagen

**We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

**Creative Operations & Project Management

**

• Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

• Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

• Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing Operations, Production, and Technology teams to align priorities, optimize resources, and ensure successful delivery.

• Establish operational KPIs and reporting to measure workflow effectiveness, resource utilization, delivery performance, and business impact.

• Lead and develop Creative Operations capabilities through coaching, best practices, and process excellence.

**Technology, AI & Operational Excellence

**

• Partner with Digital & Technology teams to evaluate, select, and implement creative technology solutions, including DAM, workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

• Develop business cases and investment plans that improve creative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and scalability.

• Establish governance, adoption frameworks, and responsible-use practices for AI and emerging technologies.

• Monitor industry trends and translate innovation into practical improvements across creative operations and content production.

**Agency & Vendor Management

**

• Lead relationships with external design, localization, customization, and technology partners, ensuring alignment with brand, quality, budget, and delivery expectations.

• Manage SOWs, contracts, performance metrics, and ongoing vendor effectiveness.

• Evaluate partner capabilities and identify opportunities to leverage innovation, automation, and emerging production models.

**Change Management & Transformation

**

• Lead change initiatives that enable successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.

• Drive continuous improvement and build organizational capability in creative operations, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

• Influence stakeholders across the business to deliver sustainable transformation and measurable impact.

**Budget & Resource Management

**

• Own budget planning for Creative Operations systems, technology investments, and operational needs in partnership with the Head of Production.

• Forecast and optimize resource allocation across internal teams and external partners.

• Partner with Finance and Production to monitor spend, measure ROI, and drive efficiency across people, processes, and technology.

**Qualifications & Experience

**

• Significant experience in Creative Operations, Project Management, Marketing Operations, or workflow transformation within an in-house agency, creative organization, or related environment.

• Experience leading or shaping creative operations functions, operating models, or large-scale transformation initiatives.

• Expertise in enterprise project management, DAM, MRM, workflow management, and collaboration platforms (e.g., Workfront, Asana, Wrike, Bynder, Aprimo, or similar).

• Experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI-enabled or automation solutions within creative, marketing, or operational environments.

• Experience leading RFPs, developing business cases, and delivering technology implementations in partnership with Digital & Technology teams.

• Strong understanding of creative workflows across design, content production, localization, and asset management.

• Demonstrated success managing agency and vendor partnerships, including localization, customization, and technology providers.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills.

• Proven ability to drive adoption of new technologies and ways of working across complex organizations.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with budget planning, financial management, and investment prioritization.

• Passion for leveraging technology, automation, and innovation to improve creative effectiveness and operational excellence.

Reports to: VP Brand Creative

**Why Join Us?

**This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Creative Operations at Pandora. You will play a critical role in building the processes, systems, and capabilities that enable exceptional creative work at a global scale. Working across Brand Creative, Production, Marketing, and Technology, you will help define how creativity is delivered in a modern, technology-enabled organization while driving meaningful impact across the business.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Application Excellence Manager - Chocolate and Confectionary
jobs.description:
**Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery

**Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role will be based at our site in Aarhus.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global Application Excellence Manager to join AAK’s Applied Innovation organisation and serve as one of our global technical authorities within Chocolate & Confectionery Fats (CCF). Combining deep expertise in confectionery formulation, fat functionality and processing with innovation and industry knowledge, you will help strengthen AAK’s position as The Co-Development Company.

In this role, you will expand and strengthen AAK’s application knowledge by developing and validating customer-relevant proof points, leading lower-complexity product development projects and supporting Scientists on medium- and long-term innovation programmes. You will translate technical expertise into practical customer solutions that demonstrate the value of AAK’s portfolio.

Working alongside our other Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery, you will connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams, global functions and external industry stakeholders. You will help ensure knowledge and expertise are shared across regions, while identifying customer needs and market opportunities that can be translated into differentiated solutions and future innovation.

As a global technical reference point, you will support regional teams through technical guidance, training, customer projects and troubleshooting. You will also contribute to the development of AAK’s Confectionery Centre of Excellence and Customer Innovation Network, helping build capabilities and consistent application expertise across the organisation.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as a global subject matter expert in Chocolate & Confectionery applications, with deep knowledge of CCF formulation, fat functionality, processing technologies and ingredient interactions.

• Connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams and global technical functions to strengthen knowledge sharing and ensure expertise is effectively leveraged across AAK.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

_Would you like to shape the services that help colleagues communicate, collaborate and work productively every day?

_As Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of these services at GlobalConnect, with Microsoft 365 at the center of your portfolio.

You’ll combine service reliability and governance with the opportunity to shape how our collaboration and productivity services develop over time.

**To Thrive In This Role, You’ll Likely Bring

**

• Several years of experience as a Service Owner, Application Owner, Product Owner or in a similar role, with responsibility for business-critical services or platforms.

• Extensive experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online and Microsoft Entra-related dependencies.

• Experience with IT service management and governance, including service transition, incident and problem management, change management and continuous improvement.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business needs into practical, scalable IT solutions.

**About The Role And The Team

**You’ll own the lifecycle of GlobalConnect’s Collaboration & Productivity portfolio, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Copilot and other strategic collaboration platforms. Your focus will be to keep these business-critical services secure, reliable and well managed, while continuously improving them and helping set the long-term direction for the area.

You’ll be part of the Digital Workplace organization, in a team of 17 colleagues with experience in IT support, system ownership and specialist roles. Working across business and IT, you’ll also partner with Security, Identity Governance & Administration, system owners and external suppliers. Your work will help ensure employees have effective tools for communication, meetings, document collaboration, knowledge sharing and everyday productivity.

**What You’ll Be Working On

**

• Own the service lifecycle across the collaboration and productivity portfolio, ensuring clear governance, documentation, compliance and operational readiness.

• Define and monitor service-level objectives, availability and user experience; follow up on incidents and recurring problems and make improvements.

• Manage licensing, renewals, budget follow-up, cost control and supplier performance.

• Work with business and technical stakeholders to govern access, information sharing, external collaboration, retention and service lifecycles.

• Manage cross-functional change and adoption initiatives, identifying practical opportunities for automation, AI, standardization and better ways of working.

• Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, connecting employee needs with operational, technical, security and strategic priorities.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You bring structure and a pragmatic approach to service management, and you’re comfortable moving between strategic development and day-to-day operational priorities. You build effective working relationships across business and technical teams, and can assess dependencies, risks and competing needs to move work forward. You’re curious about how collaboration services can evolve, including through responsible use of automation and AI.

Does this sound like you? If so, we’d like to hear from you.

**Practical information

**

• The role is based in Denmark.

• GlobalConnect’s standard setup is at least 3 days per week in the office.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

In this role, you’ll have the scope to shape a broad, business-critical portfolio and help make everyday collaboration more secure, reliable and effective for employees.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

**About Us

**GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

Director - AI & Data Advisory

The role:

NNIT is strengthening its Advisory & AI capability to help life sciences clients turn AI and data ambition into

measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a Director to lead the AI & Data Advisory team, combining

management consulting leadership, commercial accountability, people management and a strong understanding

of AI and data in regulated environments.

The Director will be accountable for building a high-performing, market-facing team that opens senior client

conversations, originates and converts opportunities, delivers high-quality management consulting

engagements and develops relevant offerings based on market demand. The role sits in AI & Data Advisory

under Advisory & AI and works across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and cross-functional regulated

capabilities and connects client needs to NNIT domain and technology specialists, including the AI Factory in

the Philippines.

This is not a technology delivery leadership role. The Director must understand AI, data and the associated

regulatory considerations in depth to advise senior stakeholders, shape compelling propositions, and mobilize

the right specialists. The primary mandate is to grow and lead a commercially successful management

consulting team.

Your responsibilities as Director - AI & Data Advisory:

Lead and develop the AI & Data Advisory team: Set clear direction and priorities for the team and hold

responsibility for performance, development, engagement, staffing and capacity. Lead the team through regular

one-to-ones, performance and development conversations, coaching and clear follow-up. Build a culture of

commercial ownership, collaboration and high-quality consulting.

Drive commercial growth: Own the commercial performance of the area and work closely with Sales, account

teams and the Life Sciences business areas to build qualified pipeline, originate opportunities and convert them

into bookings and revenue. Maintain visibility of pipeline, utilization, delivery outlook and capability needs, and

intervene early where progress is off track.

Build trusted executive client relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders

across life sciences. Lead strategic client conversations, frame business challenges, build executive alignment

and position NNIT as a trusted management consulting partner for AI- and data-enabled transformation.

Oversee high-impact management consulting engagements: Ensure that engagements are well shaped,

commercially sound and delivered to a high standard. Provide senior oversight on complex assignments

covering AI strategy and governance, AI readiness, data and analytics strategy, AI-enabled quality and

continuous improvement, transformation programs, and AI-enabled operating models.

Develop and commercialize the offering portfolio: Own the direction and commercial relevance of the AI &

Data Advisory portfolio. Ensure that existing offerings are positioned and delivered consistently, using the AI

Value Compass as one example. Convert recurring client needs, market developments and delivery experience

into new or improved offerings, methods, executive workshop formats, commercial narratives, pricing logic and

reusable assets.

Connect advisory to implementation and scale: Ensure that advisory engagements create credible pathways

into transformation, implementation, validation and managed services where relevant. Maintain clear ownership across advisory, Life Sciences domains and technology delivery, while avoiding the creation of a separate

technology silo.

Bridge to the AI Factory and wider NNIT capabilities: Act as the senior commercial and consulting link

between client demand, NNIT business areas and the AI Factory in the Philippines. Ensure opportunities are

properly qualified and shaped before technical mobilization, with clear scope, value case, governance and

accountabilities.

Shape proposals and commercial models: Lead or quality-assure major proposals, RfPs, Statements of

Work and commercial cases. Ensure that scope, pricing, delivery model, responsibilities, risk and expected

client outcomes are explicit and support healthy growth.

Strengthen market position: Represent NNIT in relevant client forums, industry events and selected thoughtleadership activities. Build external credibility around management consulting, responsible AI, data strategy and

regulated execution, grounded in tangible client outcomes.

Collaborate across the operating model: Work across Advisory & AI, R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain,

Sales and shared capabilities to bring the best of NNIT to each client. Reinforce common priorities, clear

ownership and integrated account development rather than creating parallel structures.

What the team will work on:

The team’s management consulting engagements may include:

• AI strategy, governance and readiness assessments for regulated life sciences organisations

• Data and analytics strategy, data readiness and trusted data foundations for AI

• AI-enabled Quality, risk, knowledge management and continuous improvement

• AI transformation programs, adoption and value-realisation roadmaps

• Agentic workflows and AI-enabled operating model design with appropriate human oversight and

governance

• AI and data discovery and value-assessment engagements, including the AI Value Compass where relevant

• Client-specific AI and data propositions shaped with NNIT domain specialists and delivered with appropriate

technology capabilities, including the AI Factory

Your qualifications and experience:

• 12+ years of relevant management consulting experience, preferably from a recognized strategy,

management or technology consulting firm, with a strong record in life sciences or other regulated

industries.

• Proven experience leading and developing a consulting team, including performance management,

capability development, staffing, recruitment and creating clear accountability.

• Strong commercial track record with accountability for pipeline, opportunity origination, bookings, revenue

and account growth.

• Demonstrated ability to build C-level relationships, open new client conversations and convert strategic

dialogue into material consulting and transformation engagements.

• Proven management consulting toolkit, including hypothesis-led problem solving, executive facilitation,

transformation and operating model design, quantitative value-case development and board-level

storytelling.

• Sufficient understanding of AI strategy, responsible AI and governance, data strategy, analytics, GenAI and

agentic approaches to advise executives, challenge assumptions and work credibly with specialists. Deep

hands-on engineering or architecture expertise is not required.

• Life sciences experience strongly preferred, including an understanding of regulated environments and the

implications of GxP, quality, validation, privacy and data governance for AI-enabled solutions.

• Experience developing, productizing and commercializing consulting offerings based on client demand and

market insight.

• Ability to mobilize multidisciplinary and distributed teams across management consulting, life sciences

domains, architecture, data/AI and global delivery.

• Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. Fluency in English is required.

Experienced in German is preferred.

What success looks like:

• The team has clear priorities, strong engagement and visible individual accountability, with development and

performance actively managed.

• The area builds a healthy, qualified pipeline and converts it into profitable consulting revenue and broader

NNIT opportunities.

• Clients recognize NNIT as a trusted management consulting partner able to connect AI and data ambition

with measurable business outcomes in regulated environments.

• The offering portfolio remains commercially relevant and evolves based on recurring client needs, market

insight and evidence from delivery.

• Advisory engagements lead to credible roadmaps and, where appropriate, downstream transformation,

implementation, validation and managed-service opportunities.

• The AI Factory and other delivery capabilities are connected to well-shaped demand with clear scope, value

cases and ownership.

• The team collaborates effectively across the operating model and strengthens strategic client relationships

without creating a separate silo.

Why join Advisory & AI:

This role offers the opportunity to build and lead a management consulting team at the front of NNIT’s client

agenda. You will shape senior client conversations, drive commercial growth, develop people and ensure that

NNIT’s AI and data propositions remain relevant, differentiated and connected to tangible execution across the

Life Sciences portfolio.

About NNIT:

NNIT provides consulting and IT services to life sciences and other regulated organisations. We combine deep

domain expertise, advisory, technology and global delivery to create tangible customer impact. In this role, that

means leading a team that brings AI and data into real regulated business contexts and ensures that executive

ambition is translated into commercial opportunities and scalable client outcomes.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Job Description

****Key Responsibilities

**

• Support the planning, setup, and execution of global clinical trials, ensuring activities are delivered in accordance with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure trial oversight by maintaining accurate documentation and participating in inspection readiness activities.

• Collaborate with CROs and internal stakeholders to support site feasibility, selection, activation, and ongoing site management.

• Drive in the oversight of service providers, tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality to ensure alignment with study expectations.

• Support risk identification and mitigation activities, contributing to risk-based quality management throughout the trial lifecycle.

• Drive in managing protocol deviations and trial-level issues, ensuring proper documentation, follow-up, and escalation as needed.

• Support trial data review and performance tracking, contributing to reporting and identification of potential issues.

• Work collaboratively within a global, matrixed team environment, building strong relationships with internal teams, vendors, and investigators.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• 5+ years of experience in clinical trial management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Solid understanding of ICH/GCP regulations and the clinical drug development lifecycle.

• Experience managing global, multi-center trials and working in a complex, matrixed organization.

• Project management and service provider oversight skills.

• Good communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.

• Oncology and/or therapeutic area–specific experience is highly desirable.

The proposed gross annual base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK620.160,00---930.240,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on compensation and benefits will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Associate/Sr. Associate, Flagship Portfolio Management Team
jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for an Associate/Sr. Associate to join our Flagship Portfolio Management Team based in Copenhagen.

**Team

**The Flagship Portfolio Management team sits at the heart of our investment platform, overseeing the performance, strategy, and long‑term value creation of our largest and most strategic funds. The team manages the full lifecycle of portfolio assets by monitoring financial and operational performance, analyzing market and asset‑level developments, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring alignment with fund strategy. Working closely with investment teams, asset managers, and senior leadership, the team develops portfolio models, reporting frameworks, and decision‑support materials that guide both day‑to‑day management and long‑term planning. Joining the Flagship Portfolio Management team means contributing directly to the success of high‑profile funds in a dynamic, analytical, and collaborative environment

**Role

**You will play a key role in supporting the management and performance oversight of our flagship funds. You’ll gain exposure to high‑profile assets, collaborate with experienced professionals across the organization, and contribute directly to the performance of our flagship funds. It’s an ideal environment for someone who thrives in analytical, fast‑paced settings and wants to play a meaningful role in shaping portfolio outcomes.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Support the ongoing monitoring and analysis of portfolio performance across Flagship funds

• Maintain, update, and enhance portfolio models, dashboards, and reporting tools

• Prepare high‑quality materials for investment committees, senior management, and investor reporting

• Conduct financial analysis, scenario modelling, and forecasting to support strategic decision‑making

• Track key performance indicators, market trends, and asset‑level developments

• Identify risks and opportunities within the portfolio and support follow‑up actions

• Collaborate closely with investment teams, asset managers, and other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with fund strategy

• Assist in preparing portfolio reviews, valuation updates, and fund‑level presentations

• Contribute to process improvements and the development of best‑practice portfolio management frameworks

**You

**You are holding a university degree in finance, economic, business or a related field and 1–4 years of relevant experience in investment management, portfolio management, corporate finance, consulting, or a similar analytical role.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Ability to interpret complex data and communicate insights clearly to senior stakeholders

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proficiency in creating high-quality PowerPoint presentations

• Self-starter with a structured and disciplined approach to your work, the ability to connect the dots independently, and to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Solid financial modelling skills and solid understanding of valuation, forecasting, and performance analysis

• Excellent analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with a high level of attention to detail

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with BI tools or data analytics is a plus

• Comfortable working with large datasets and multiple information sources

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams

• High level of professionalism, ownership, and motivation to contribute to fund‑level decision‑making

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our Commercial Excellence team as Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights.

At DFDS, we are strengthening how we use pricing, customer data and commercial insights to improve profitability, support growth and create greater value for our customers.

As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will drive the development of pricing capabilities, help establish a stronger customer data foundation and turn commercial data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the business.

You will join our Commercial Excellence team, which works across DFDS to enable more efficient, data-driven and profitable commercial operations. Through common tools, processes and insights, we help strengthen commercial performance while supporting local business ownership and flexibility.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.

About The Role As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will own and drive DFDS' pricing excellence and commercial insights agenda across a complex, international business.

This is a highly strategic role focused on strengthening pricing capabilities, improving commercial decision-making, and unlocking value from customer and commercial data. Working across business units and functions, you will lead key transformation initiatives, establish scalable frameworks and best practices, and drive the adoption of tools, processes, and data-driven ways of working.

Operating in a highly decentralized organisation, you will balance the implementation of common standards and governance with the need for local ownership and commercial flexibility.

Pricing Excellence and Commercial Insights is an area of increasing strategic importance and executive attention. You will play a key role in elevating its maturity and impact, working closely with Commercial leadership, Data & Technology, Customer Engagement, Tender Management, and Tools & Processes to deliver measurable business value.

**Key priorities

**

• Drive the Pricing Excellence strategy across business units, establishing governance, standards and best practices while enabling local flexibility

• Own the business vision and roadmap for our pricing platform, ensuring continuous development, adoption and value creation

• Lead the digitalisation of pricing processes across CRM, contract management and pricing solutions

• Build and mature Commercial Insights capabilities, transforming data into actionable recommendations and commercial decision support

• Shape the long-term strategy for our customer data foundation in partnership with Data & Technology

• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce revenue leakage through analytics, automation and AI

• Facilitate alignment, collaboration and knowledge sharing across business units and senior stakeholders

• Translate complex data and insights into clear recommendations for management and commercial leadership

**About You

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built through diverse perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

With this in mind, we think that you are a strategic and commercially minded professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning insights into action. You combine strong analytical capabilities with the ability to influence stakeholders, challenge existing ways of working and drive change across a matrix organisation.

You thrive at the intersection of business, data and technology and are motivated by creating tangible commercial impact through pricing excellence, customer insights and continuous improvement.

We think the ideal person for this position will bring the following:

• 5+ years of relevant experience within Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Revenue Management, Strategy, Management Consulting, Business Development, Finance, Analytics or a related field

• A strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority

• Experience operating in complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• A strategic mindset combined with the ability to translate ideas and opportunities into practical solutions and business outcomes

• Experience working with commercial tools and platforms such as CRM, pricing, CPQ, contract management or business intelligence solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations

• Interest in leveraging data, automation and AI to improve commercial performance and decision-making

• The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and confidently to both operational teams and senior stakeholders

• A curiosity for understanding customers, commercial processes and business drivers, combined with a willingness to challenge the status quo

Working at DFDS

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Ambu is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join our GI & Urology solutions team in Global R&D. As a Solutions Architect within our Research and Development (R&D) team at Ambu, you will play a key role in designing and implementing innovative solutions that advance our single use endoscopy solutions. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and collaboration skills to drive the development of cutting-edge solutions that meet the needs of our customers and contribute to the growth and success of our organization.

Apply today and join us for a career #ForeverForward!

In our global R&D team, where we develop medical devices, we have a great culture and a clear focus on bringing products to the market that are based on a thorough understanding of the customer's needs. We focus on developing customer centric products that combine several technologies in new and innovative ways. This role requires exceptional architectural skills, a deep understanding of both business and technical aspects, and solid medical device experience.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Engage with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, and internal teams to understand requirements and translate them into actionable technical solutions.

• Collaborate closely with product management to define product roadmaps and prioritize feature development based on customer needs and market opportunities.

• Participate in and support early phase investigations and exploratory research initiatives aimed at identifying new opportunities and technologies for potential integration into future product offerings.

• Collaborate with R&D subject matter experts and teams to conduct feasibility studies, prototype development, and proof-of-concept demonstrations to assess the viability and potential impact of emerging technologies on medical device innovation.

• Provide technical expertise and guidance to inform decision-making processes during the evaluation and selection of technologies for inclusion in future product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and market needs.

• Support early-stage new product development projects with solution architecture.

• Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to inform solution architecture decisions and drive innovation within the organization.

• Lead the architecture of complex solutions combining mechanical, electronics and software for our medical technology products and services, considering factors such as scalability, security, reliability, sustainability, and performance.

• Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the solution lifecycle, ensuring adherence to architectural best practices and alignment with organizational goals.

• Mentor and coach team members on architectural principles, design patterns, and standards to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

• Continuously monitor and evaluate existing solutions to identify opportunities for optimization to improve scalability, efficiency, and maintainability.

Suggested candidate profile Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a master’s degree in engineering and have technical work experience.

• Proven experience as a Solutions Architect or similar role in a medical technology or healthcare environment.

• In-depth knowledge of relevant technologies and platforms for single use medical devices.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels and articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Demonstrated leadership abilities with a track record of successfully leading cross-functional teams and driving projects to completion.

• Creative problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation, coupled with a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

• Strong team player and collaborative skills in a cross functional and international setting

It is a requirement that you are fluent in oral and written English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

**Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

**Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

**As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management 📈

**You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients.

Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work.

Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves.

• You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs.

• You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests.

• You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input.

• You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend.

You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required.

**We value your passion 🔥

**At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

**What We Can Offer You 🌱

**

• The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients.

• Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows.

• A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.

Location: Hillerød, Denmark

Job category: Global Manufacturing & Supply

Department: Sustainability & Operational Excellence, Drug Delivery Innovation (DDI), Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS)

Your impact begins here

As Circularity Lead, you will make circular design part of everyday product development for the drug delivery de-vices and packaging that support people living with serious chronic diseases. You will turn circularity knowledge into practical guidance, influence development teams and keep products on track against our Circular for Zero strategy. Your work will shape how future products are designed, reduce their environmental footprint and help Global Manufacturing & Supply advance lasting health and a healthier planet together.

What you'll bring

• Practical experience applying sustainability and circularity to products

• Understanding of circular design principles and environmental knowledge you can apply in product development

• Hands-on experience in product design, product development or a closely related environment

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the confidence to reach out proactively across the organization

• The ability to influence development teams so sustainability requirements get the attention and resources they need

• Comfort working with data, including strong practical Excel skills

• A relevant academic background, such as Environmental Engineering, Engineering, Design & Innovation or sustainability-related studies. A relevant commercial background is also considered alongside strong professional experience

• Fluency in written and spoken English

Useful, but not essential:

• Direct circular design experience in a product setting

• Knowledge of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), including carbon footprint calculations and working with specialist LCA colleagues

• Experience with sustainable materials, plastics, recycling, non-fossil plastics or material innovation

• Experience from pharma, medical devices or a comparable product development environment

You are collaborative and proactive, structured and pragmatic, and curious about the latest trends in circularity. Deep expertise matters, but so does your ability to bring people with you.

What you'll do

You will connect circularity knowledge with product development, guiding teams and driving projects that move our sustainability goals forward.

• Ensure a state-of-the-art approach to circular design in drug delivery devices and packaging, tracking market trends and keeping the Circular Design Guideline up to date

• Provide scientific support on circularity, carbon footprint and plastic footprint, and guide project teams in interpreting circularity assessments

• Anchor Circular for Zero targets in DDI projects and drive circularity progress in key projects, including tools, assessments and process deliverables

• Act as Circular for Zero Process Manager, developing sustainability processes and building capabilities through training

• Drive key cross-organizational projects and share success stories that engage colleagues and stakeholders

Who you'll work with

You will join the Sustainability & Operational Excellence team within Drug Delivery Innovation (DDI), reporting to the Associate Director of Sustainability & Operational Excellence. The team drives and guides sustainability across all DDI areas through capability building, project support and clear communication, and is also responsible for integrating lean principles across DDI.

Your closest partners will be DDI project and programme managers, product developers, designers and engineers as well as commercial colleagues and environmental leads and experts in HQ.

Based in Hillerød, you will work with key stakeholders in Denmark across functions and organizational levels, creating clarity and momentum where circular design meets product development.

What you can expect here

You will work in a collaborative environment where your expertise shapes how future products are designed and made. You can broaden your perspective across the value chain, build new skills and take ownership of complex challenges that often have no precedent.

You will be trusted to make your voice heard and support to perform at your best, as part of a team that combines curiosity, collaboration and ambition to create meaningful progress.

What we offer

At Novo, you will join a global healthcare company with a distinctive culture and a strong track record. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 742,600 to DKK 1,091,600, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives, together with other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring circular design to life in the products that support people living with serious chronic diseases, apply for the Circularity Lead role by 19th November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Nanja Hedal Kløverpris, Assoc Director, Sustainability & Operational Excellence, at nnhk@novonordisk.com.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

jobs.occupation: Design for Value & Cost Engineer – from concept to competitive edge, GN Hearing, Ballerup hos ReSound
jobs.description:
Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup.

The Team You Will Be Part Of

Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist.

In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production.

Your Contribution Is Appreciated And You Will

• Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture

• Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options

• Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects

• Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations

• Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing

• Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing

• Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection

You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed.

You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective.

Role

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have:

• A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics

• Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators

• Good at solving both technical and commercial issues

• General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization

• Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators

• Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken

In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions.

You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start.

We Offer

• A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business

• A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence

• Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company.

• The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN

• An international and collaborative workplace

We encourage you to apply

We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our leading intelligent hearing, inspired by people and driven by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**Stillingsbeskrivelse

**_Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

_**Responsibilities And Technologies

**Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting
